$comment: 'Fully qualified accountant (ACCA)' does not say whether an equivalent will do, so accept_equivalents defaults to true with equivalents_stated false: the employer confirms it at intake. UK role: ACCA required (no US certification), Anaplan and Excel required, SQL and Power BI or Looker only desirable. 'Ideally within three months' is not a start date. Written to match the London FP&A resume.

requirements.title: FP&A Manager
must_haves: 6+ years in FP&A or commercial finance, including 2+ years managing people
Anaplan model-building experience (Level 2 or equivalent hands-on experience)
Advanced Excel modelling and the ability to present to senior stakeholders
Right to work in the UK; based in or commutable to London
nice_to_haves: SQL and experience querying a data warehouse directly
Power BI or Looker for management reporting
Experience in a business that has raised venture capital
